samples.reasoning: Behavioral reconstruction of an operational OneDrive tasking agent. Main reads DRIVE_TOKEN for its own authorization, lists Graph drive children in a 30-second loop, and dispatches filename-suffix opcodes. Tasks execute downloaded managed assemblies and upload their results, upload arbitrary remotely selected local files, or download an item and write it to the remotely selected path. Not attributed to BlackX or any recovered campaign. No legitimate management interface or restricted administrative workflow is present; unknown deployment and payload success do not erase the executable command/exfiltration behavior.

samples.reasoning: Integgri Conector 1.0.0, Manifest V3, extension ID jpjfdpppffhbpikchfbhigpajemmjllm. Popup requires the user to enter a connection code and invoke CONNECT. Background injects the extractor into an existing WhatsApp tab, sends the returned session and extensionToken to the branded configured backend, and clears localStorage/reloads only after successful response. The extractor reads wawc_db_enc and signal-storage, derives HKDF/AES-CBC keys, decrypts Noise and Signal identity/prekey material with AES-CBC/CTR, generates an ephemeral X25519 key pair, and serializes credentials as Base64. This is disclosed session migration with no discovered covert trigger, remote code loading, or unrelated recipient. Debug JSON download requires manual console invocation. Backend implementation, actual user authorization in a deployment, and runtime success are unavailable. README localhost claim is stale; shipped ENV=prod selects https://iapi.integgri.com.br. Code clears only localStorage, despite a broader cleanup comment.

rule_changes.change: Hostile to suspicious, with acquisition placement and co-occurrence description. Preserve the required match set and existing exclusions. Real disclosed, user-invoked connector is a benign match; neither source-to-send binding nor unauthorized transfer is required by the old matcher.

Parse object pairs and enum members, excluding the comment-only false match in extractor.js while retaining real configuration in background.js, options variables, and the hostile eval-proxy control. Description now claims a configuration reference rather than proving injection.

Require decryption rather than either encrypt/decrypt reference; describe session reads with decryption clues. Existing suspicious extraction preserved in real connector and positive decrypt control; encryption-only near miss excluded.

Move with exact matchers, platforms, file scope and proximity preserved. Move its private-key-export-wording atom too. Wording/reference co-occurrence does not itself prove exported private bytes. No exact consumers or asymmetric ancestor selectors found; crypto ancestor membership preserved.

Add notable WebCrypto generateKey/exportKey call detections and AES-CBC algorithm literal; raise complete session key/device field alternative groups from component to notable; correct field-reference descriptions.

validation_evidence.controls: Actual hostile extension-message-eval-proxy.js and extension-remote-native-tasking.zip retain hostile detections; real original Integgri CRX retained as a BENIGN review specimen outside the global benign-fixture policy. Positive/negative controls cover parsed code versus comments, options aliases and enum spelling, unrelated generateKey/exportKey methods, and decrypt versus encrypt. Ordinary controls are registered in testdata/expectations.toml; sensitive session-access cases are checked separately by check.py because the global benign-fixture policy rejects accurate suspicious objective findings.
validation_evidence.python_dispatch: Both sources executed with inert replacement modules for every network, filesystem and CLR sink. All opcode branches trace their documented dataflow; unknown suffixes have no effects. Trace JSON retained in scratch/fallout-review/dispatch-traces.json.
validation_evidence.facts: cleave facts run for each original input, and extractor.js examined separately. No hidden executable encoding/obfuscated stage found. Base64 encodes and decodes session bytes, with no evaluation sink.
validation_evidence.classifier_limit: Atomscan warns model feature spec v18 is older than v21. Local full scans still classify Integgri HOSTILE, despite corrected YAML producing zero hostile findings; keep as classifier false positive rather than suppressing accurate sensitive operations.
